text: Clue isi video mein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!

Police ne parivaar ko\nbas itna bataya...
"Seth ji nahi rahe.\nMaut kaise hui, report\naane par pata chalega."
"Raat bhar vakil sahab\nke saath zameen ke\nkaagaz dekh raha tha"
BHATEEJA MONU\n"Kal raat ghar par\ntha hi nahi!"
CHOWKIDAR HARIYA\n"10 baje ke baad ek\naadmi andar aaya"
